meta.title: Port Wrap with Tag endpoint to cohosting
meta.body_summary: Port the existing WrapWithTag endpoint to the cohosting architecture for better performance and memory usage via out-of-process execution and shared logic.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot ported WrapWithTag to cohosting, fixed all review comments (IDynamicRegistrationProvider, LspRange type, code sharing), but PR closed by maintainer after feedback resolution; likely integrated via alternative channel.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Medium-sized cohosting migration (694 lines across 8 files). The PR was closed after all review comments were addressed, indicating maintainer may have integrated changes via an alternative path rather than directly merging this PR.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer requested removal of unnecessary IDynamicRegistrationProvider, change LspRange to LinePositionSpan for MessagePack serialization, and refactor duplicated logic into a shared WrapWithTagHelper. All issues were resolved in subsequent commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Remote service execution reduces devenv memory usage and improves performance vs. in-process.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge after all feedback resolved; no explicit rejection reason.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot correctly addressed technical feedback (serialization, code sharing) but the PR was not merged, suggesting process boundaries (alternative integration) also played a role.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed via inline comments, catching unnecessary interface, LspRange type mismatch, and code duplication; no profiler or CI evidence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks provided; change was architectural.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After all issues were fixed, maintainer closed the PR without merging.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced new remote service IRemoteWrapWithTagService and RemoteWrapWithTagService to handle wrap-with-tag logic out-of-process, added CohostWrapWithTagEndpoint in the Visual Studio layer, refactored shared validation logic into WrapWithTagHelper to eliminate code duplication, and updated serialization to LinePositionSpan.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Unit tests added; existing WrapWithTagEndpoint updated to use shared helper.
change_trajectory: Initial implementation added cohost endpoint and remote service with copied logic.
Addressed maintainer feedback: removed IDynamicRegistrationProvider, switched LspRange to LinePositionSpan, created shared WrapWithTagHelper, and refactored both endpoints to use it.

review_signals.summary: The cohost endpoint does not need to implement IDynamicRegistrationProvider; remove it.
LspRange type won't work with MessagePack; use LinePositionSpan instead.
review_signals.action_taken: Changed interface and implementation to LinePositionSpan in commit fdbcebd.

review_signals.summary: Create a shared WrapWithTagHelper in Workspaces to avoid copying logic; update original endpoint too.
review_signals.action_taken: Created WrapWithTagHelper and refactored both endpoints in commit fdbcebd.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial cohosting implementation; maintainer reviewed within minutes requesting three design changes.
Copilot addressed each issue in subsequent commits, removing unnecessary registration, fixing serialization types, and refactoring shared logic.
After all feedback resolved, maintainer closed PR without merge; a later referenced commit suggests possible alternative integration.
